name: @mesh/hyprland-apps
description: Pinned, running and installed applications for docks and launchers: XDG desktop entries joined with Hyprland clients, launched and focused through hyprctl.

capabilities: exec.argv:sh:["-c", "for b in \"${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}\" \"$HOME/.nix-profile/share\" $(printf %s \"${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}\" | tr : \" \"); do for t in Papirus-Light Papirus Papirus-Dark Adwaita hicolor; do for s in scalable 256x256 128x128 96x96 64x64 48x48; do for c in apps categories; do for e in svg png; do f=\"$b/icons/$t/$s/$c/$1.$e\"; [ -f \"$f\" ] && { printf %s \"$f\"; exit 0; }; done; done; done; done; for e in svg png; do f=\"$b/pixmaps/$1.$e\"; [ -f \"$f\" ] && { printf %s \"$f\"; exit 0; }; done; done; exit 1", "sh", "*"]

exec.argv:sh:["-c","for d in \"${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}\" \"$HOME/.nix-profile/share\" $(printf %s \"${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}\" | tr : \" \"); do [ -d \"$d/applications\" ] && ls \"$d/applications\"; done; exit 0"]

binaries.name: hyprctl
binaries.reason: List clients, focus windows and launch applications.

pinned.description: Desktop entry ids (file names without .desktop) pinned in order.
